The two labels are clearly associated. In the crosstab, lateral elbow pain appears in 15% of patients with L C6 radiculopathy and in 3% of those without it. The data can't settle the direction. I chose B on domain knowledge: a compressed or irritated C6 nerve root produces pain in its dermatome, and a symptom like elbow pain does not cause a root lesion.

ANSWER: B
